name: d1_model_comparison
notes: qwen3.5:4b baseline vs qwen3.5:9b challenger under frozen d1-investigator-v3 (2026-09-20 decision).
Model choice is the one variable: prompts, schema, budgets, verifier and scoring are frozen; compare refuses anything else.
No --ignore-ram-floor. Every model run happens on Colab or a rented machine, never on the laptop.
frozen_surface_sha256 identifies the checkout by what it computes, not by a commit id (the public history is rewritten).
